scope: Numeric provider allowance observations around exactly one authorized independent chatbot conversation
command: Read-only GET https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/key with server-side credential loaded in memory; output restricted to numeric limit/usage/remaining and reset-null flag
limitations: Provider accounting can lag; the observed delta is not a final invoice.
No provider credential, label or response body is retained.
Only the chatbot conversation used inference; browser regressions were intercepted.
